en: A colorized historic view over a European town with red-tiled roofs. Dominating the scene are a large church with twin towers and onion-shaped domes and, to the right, a fortified complex with round towers and a gabled building, resembling a castle. In the distance are flat fields under a blue sky. The printed captions read "Wurzen." at the upper left and "Dom u. Schloss." at the upper right.
